**It cannot be determined from this evidence whether forest protection rules were violated.**

The data support about 0.6 ha of tree-cover loss on the property in 2022, of which 0.5 ha was mapped as native forest. However, the observations do not establish the cause of the loss, whether it involved deforestation or land-use change, or whether it was authorized.

A compliance finding would require further investigation, including the applicable rules and any relevant permits or authorizations.
